messages:
Alex: Heads-up — noticed a seeded-context warmup hit-rate collapse on staging after the attn_vectorize rollout. p50 token latency +18ms and cache hit-rate dropped hard.
Priya: ugh. numbers? which rollout exactly (flag/commit)?
Alex: deploy-bot says attn_vectorize=v2 + aq8-quant profile, rolled at 2801233600 to staging-1
Alex: quick metrics snapshot from /metrics/prefix_cache (5m window):
```
prefix_cache_hit_rate: 0.621
prefix_cache_requests: 41234
p50_token_latency_ms: 32.4 (was 14.1 before)
```
Sam: that's a huge delta. any errors in logs (key collisions, normalization warnings)?
Alex: grep shows lots of "kvkey_mismatch" from batcher:
```
2026-03-18T15:20:11Z batcher[pid=42] WARN kvkey_mismatch prompt_hash=0x7fa9...
2026-03-18T15:20:11Z runtime[pid=8] DEBUG kv-fingerprint computed=(len=64,dtype=fp32) expected=(len=64,dtype=int8)
```
Morgan: could be the quantized kernel changing dtype or memory layout, which affects our fingerprint routine. We compute fingerprint over raw prefix bytes + token ids — if kernel reorders padding bytes (vectorize reorder) hash changes.
Jenna: Confirmed — I ran a tiny repro: send the exact same prompt through old kernel vs new attn_vectorize. The computed key hex differs by one byte at offset 16. Repro steps:
```
echo "hello world" | ./runtime_client --kernel=attn_old --get-prefix-key > key_old.hex
echo "hello world" | ./runtime_client --kernel=attn_vectorize --get-prefix-key > key_new.hex
hexdiff key_old.hex key_new.hex
```
Alex: interesting — the diff is stable for that kernel combo (same offset). Not random.
Priya: so not a nondet threading issue. More like a deterministic layout change. Which part of key includes positional padding? our prefix key = sha256(prefix_bytes || seq_len || build_id) right?
Sam: yes. If prefix_bytes are taken from KV cache writer reading a padded buffer, and attn_vectorize writes padding in a different order (matmul vector lanes), that will flip bytes.
Morgan: possible fixes: canonicalize prefix extraction (trim paddings) or add canonical serializer before hashing. Quick mitigation: enable key_salt=v2 for staging (salt absorbs layout change and prevents collisions with prod) — but that reduces cross-kernel cache portability.
Jenna: deploy-bot: can we temporarily toggle key_salt for staging? @deploy-bot any ETA/backfill plan?
deploy-bot: Release 2026.03.18.attn_vectorize-2 deployed to staging-1 at 2801233600. To flip config: use /ops/flags key_salt=v2 on staging-1. No automated backfill for salted keys.
Alex: if we salt, we need to warm the cache quickly. Current warmup relies on cross-instance prefix reuse. Salt will make warmup cold.
Priya: alternative short-term: roll attn_vectorize back on staging and run a canonicalizer fix on master branch. We should pick one immediate action.
Sam: quick experiment results — canonicalizing by trimming trailing zero bytes before hash fixes hit-rate in my local harness (hit_rate -> 0.985). Sample patch:
```
// before hashing
auto buf = read_prefix_buffer();
// after
auto canonical = trim_trailing_padding(buf);
sha = sha256(canonical || seq_len || buildid);
```
Morgan: sounds low-risk. But need to be careful: some models legitimately include zero bytes in the middle of prefix encoding (rare), trimming trailing zeros seems safe because padding is always trailing by our encoder.
Jenna: test matrix: run across llama-like and flan variants, compiled with attn_vectorize + attn_old, quant=aq8 and fq16. We should verify across seq lengths 64/256/1024.
Alex: I'll run a quick AB on staging with canonicalizer patch on a canary pool of 4 GPUs. Timeline: 1hr to build, 30m deploy, 15m collect.
Priya: also record per-request key diffs for 1% sample so we can audit potential data skew. Add a metric kvkey_mismatch_rate.
Sam: Added a tiny check-in patch to drop trailing 0x00. Pushed to branch fix/canonicalize-prefix-2026-03-18.
Morgan: If that stabilizes, follow-up: add unit tests for serialization (roundtrip old kernel vs new) and a migration plan to allow salted keys for future incompatible kernel changes.
Jenna: note for release notes: "attn_vectorize changed buffer layout; runtime now canonicalizes prefix buffer before hashing to preserve cache correctness" — only after QA.
Alex: I'll post results in 2h. If hit-rate returns to ~98% we keep; otherwise rollback attn_vectorize on staging and block rollout to prod.
Priya: thanks — please @channel if rollback occurs.
Alex: thanks everyone. quick action items: 1) Alex deploy canary with patch; 2) Priya add metric; 3) Sam run cross-model tests; 4) Jenna coordinate QA.
:eyes:
